thought.text: The bootstrap ran on an earlier failed attempt (volumes persisted) before the users could be added. The LDAP is now up and healthy — let me load the users directly using the admin credentials.

reasoning_content:
The bootstrap was already completed on the previous failed attempt (the LDAP volume persisted across recreates). The users were never added during any bootstrap. The cleanest fix is to manually load the ldif now into the running openldap with admin credentials.

Let me load the test_users.ldif into the LDAP using the admin credentials from the compose file: LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin, base dc=example,dc=org.

action.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && docker exec -i ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapadd -x -H ldap://localhost -D "cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org" -w "admin" -f - < /workspace/.ddev/ldap-seed/test_users.ldif' 2>&1 | tail -20
